tC4 vendors no Greek New Testament. The text is the pinned release, v0.34, from translationCore 3's bundle (verse-object JSON written back to USFM by usfm-js); every word agrees both ways with the ULT v89 alignment of Titus. The file is rebuilt, not the export's bytes, and the metadata is the en_ult v89 export metadata renamed

tC4 vendors no English OBS text; story 1 only, from the example story of open-bible-stories@0.0.5 (release unknown), served under the v9 identity; the metadata is the en_obs-tn v13 export metadata renamed
